name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
short: Google's canonical thinking flagship (1M context, 64K out) for long-context reasoning; AIME 92% and GPQA 84.4%, superseded by 3.x.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
standout: The generation that normalized thinking models: dependable long-context reasoning that became the template Google’s 3.x line refined.
tradeoff: Thoroughly superseded by Gemini 3.x at similar prices; it now serves migration compatibility.
